Diatonic or chromatic succession of the notes. Every octave of a diatonic scale contains seven full tones: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, si in the major scale (in Swedish: c, d, e, f, g, a, h) and la, si, di, re, mi, fa, sol in the minor scale (in Swedish a, hc, d, e, f, g), the eighth tone constituting the repetition of the higher octave. Every chromatic scale contains 12 notes in one octave, separated by a semitone: do (c), do sharp (ciss), re (d), re sharp (diss), mi (e), fa (f), fa sharp (fiss), sol (g), sol sharp (giss), la (a), la sharp (aiss), si (h) [and the repetition of do].
